## Research

::: cv-entry
::: cv-when
2025–Present
:::
::: cv-what
**African land cover change and protected area impact observed in a mega-archive of historical aerial imagery**, *In preparation*

- Developing a land cover prediction pipeline and running inference on a high performance computing system over 640,000 historical aerial images of 18 countries in sub-Saharan Africa during the 20th century
- Generating figures, calculating summary statistics, and evaluating performance metrics for a descriptive analysis of land cover change and the impact of protected areas
- Reviewing literature on earth observation of protected areas to identify a data gap
:::
:::

::: cv-entry
::: cv-when
2025
:::
::: cv-what
**Remote Sensing of Defensible Space Compliance to Enhance Wildfire Preparedness**, *Master's Capstone Project*

- Developed a machine learning model that predicts compliance with wildfire defensible space requirements from satellite imagery and annual inspection data from the Santa Barbara County Fire Department
- Designed automated workflows to match satellite imagery chips to property parcels, integrating imagery, inspection records, and property and building datasets
- Applied unsupervised and supervised learning to predict compliance using random convolutional imagery features and environmental variables
- Collaborated with faculty on causal inference research measuring the impacts of communication interventions
:::
:::

::: cv-entry
::: cv-when
2025
:::
::: cv-what
**[Santa Barbara County Political Mapping and Voter Analysis](posts/2025-03-17-voter-data-viz/SB-voter-visualization.qmd)**

- Created interactive maps and visualizations of the spatial distribution of Democratic and Republican voters across Santa Barbara County using voter registration and census data
- Analyzed voter demographics, party composition, and registration trends from 2000–2024, revealing partisan age differences and election-year registration spikes
:::
:::
